method.name: Greedy soft token matching on contextual embeddings (BERTScore without idf weighting or baseline rescaling)
method.reference: Zhang, Kishore, Wu, Weinberger, Artzi. BERTScore: Evaluating Text Generation with BERT. ICLR 2020.
method.pooling: mean of word pieces per word, unit-normalised
method.scored_tokens: content words (function words embedded in context, excluded from scores)
